description: Update a mailbox's settings without its IMAP/SMTP password. Set is_active to enable (true) or disable (false) inbound IMAP polling — a disabled mailbox is never polled, so /mail/inbox serves only its last-polled snapshot. Also updates display_name, default template settings, how far back the mailbox imports (sync_scope) and how often it is polled (poll_interval_seconds).

default_template_id.description: Default outbound template id (0 clears it)

poll_interval_seconds.description: Per-mailbox poll cadence (min 60, max 86400). Can only make a mailbox poll LESS often than the 300s platform tick, never more.

sync_scope.description: Change how far back this mailbox imports. WIDENING (e.g. 100 -> 1000, or -> all) rewinds the mailbox and re-walks from further back on the next cycle; re-ingest is de-duplicated, so nothing is doubled. NARROWING never deletes mail already imported — it only stops reaching further back. Deleting stored mail is a separate, explicit action.

sync_scope_n.description: Message count for sync_scope=last_n (max 100000). An UPPER bound, not exact — fewer than N may arrive, never more. Required with last_n; must be omitted with the other scopes.

sync_since_date.description: Cutoff date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD) for sync_scope=since_date. Required with that scope; must be omitted otherwise.

name: update_mailbox
